strings.bust: Oink. That turn total is gone.

strings.finalRound: Final round · Equal turns for everyone
strings.waitReason: Wait for your turn to roll or hold.
help: Roll a die to add to your turn total. Roll a 1 and lose only this turn’s total.
Hold to bank the total. Your timer auto-holds after 30 seconds at Normal pace. Rolling does not reset it.
Reaching the target starts the final round. Every active seat gets the same number of turns.
The highest banked total wins. Tied totals share a place. Match points are 300, 200, 100, then 0.
